name: Isoceteth-20
description: Isoceteth-20 (CAS 69364-63-2 ), also marketed as Arlasolve 200, is a polyethoxylated isocetyl alcohol with 20 ethylene oxide units. It functions as a nonionic surfactant and emulsifier across personal care, cleaning, and industrial formulations. In cosmetic emulsions, including lotions, creams, and conditioning rinses, it stabilizes oil-in-water systems and contributes a smooth skin feel that supports product elegance. Cleansing formulations for both personal care and household products use it to improve wetting. These formulations solubilize oils without disrupting foam structure. Textile processing operations apply it as a wetting and leveling agent during dyeing and finishing, where uniform fiber penetration directly affects batch quality. Leather treatment and paper coating processes also draw on its surface-modifying properties to improve substrate uniformity and coating adhesion. This versatility makes it a staple in various manufacturing sectors. Isoceteth-20 is typically supplied as a liquid or paste, depending on temperature and concentration. It is available in cosmetic-grade and industrial-grade specifications to meet the purity requirements of different end markets. Bulk supply is standard in drums or IBCs, with cosmetic-grade material commonly supported by safety and regulatory documentation for formulation compliance.
